description: The TN-01 RTO serves the central part of Chennai city, including major residential and commercial hubs. It is the primary office for vehicle registration and licensing in the central zone of the state capital, operating from its headquarters in Ayanavaram.

The Chennai (North West) Regional Transport Office, identified by the code TN-02, is one of the primary transport administrative centers in the state capital. It serves the northwestern residential and commercial corridors, managing a high volume of vehicle registrations and driving license issuances.
address: Plot No. 3623, G-17, New Avadi Road, Anna Nagar East, Chennai, Tamil Nadu

description: The TN-03 RTO serves the North-East zone of Chennai, headquartered in Tondiarpet. It is responsible for vehicle registration, driver licensing, and enforcement of transport regulations within its jurisdiction of North Chennai.
address: No. 147, Balakrishna Street, Thiruvottiyur High Road (T.H. Road), Tondiarpet, Chennai, Tamil Nadu

description: TN-04 is the Regional Transport Office serving the eastern sector of Chennai, headquartered in Pulianthoppu. It handles a high volume of commercial and private vehicle registrations, driving licenses, and road tax collections for the older, densely populated parts of the city.
address: Power Mills Road, Pulianthoppu, Chennai, Tamil Nadu

description: TN-05 is the Regional Transport Office for North Chennai, serving significant northern residential and commercial hubs like Kolathur and Vysarpadi. It oversees vehicle registration, driver licensing, and various transport-related regulatory activities for a large portion of the city's northern sector.
address: No. 9, Inner Ring Road, Sastri Nagar, Kolathur, Chennai, Tamil Nadu - 600099

description: The TN-06 Regional Transport Office (RTO) serves the South-Eastern jurisdiction of Chennai, specifically the Mandaveli area. This office is responsible for vehicle registration, driving licenses, and managing transport permits for several of Chennai's historic and densely populated neighborhoods.
address: No. 4, VC Garden II Street, Mandaveli, Chennai, Tamil Nadu

description: The TN-07 RTO serves the southern regions of Chennai city, including prime residential and commercial hubs. It is one of the busiest transport offices in the state, handling high volumes of vehicle registrations and licensing services for the Thiruvanmiyur and Adyar corridors.
address: Thiruvalluvar Nagar, East Coast Road (ECR), Thiruvanmiyur, Chennai, Tamil Nadu - 600041

description: The TN-09 RTO serves the Western region of Chennai city, headquartered at the Mambalam Taluk Office Complex in K.K. Nagar. It is one of the busiest transport offices in Tamil Nadu, handling vehicle registration and licensing for major commercial centers like T. Nagar.
address: No. 1, Mambalam Taluk Office Complex, Bharathidasan Colony, K.K. Nagar, Chennai, Tamil Nadu

description: TN-10 is the Regional Transport Office for Chennai (South-West), headquartered in Virugambakkam. This office manages vehicle registration, permits, and licensing for several key residential and commercial neighborhoods in the southwestern part of the state capital.
address: No. 47 & 49, Kaliamman Koil Street, Sai Nagar, Virugambakkam, Chennai, Tamil Nadu - 600092

description: The TN-11 RTO serves the Tambaram region, which is a major gateway to the southern suburbs of Chennai. It handles comprehensive transport services including vehicle registration, driving licenses, and commercial vehicle permits for the Chengalpattu district.
address: No. 58, Old State Bank Colony Road, West Tambaram, Chennai, Tamil Nadu
